title: Sunday Breakthrough Service
description: A dynamic Sunday celebration of apostolic worship, powerful Word, and prophetic deliverance led by Bishop Dr. David Mutweri. Experience the breakthrough anointing that shifts every dry season into supernatural overflow.

title: Mid-week Deliverance
description: Mid-week gathering for prevailing prayer, targeted spiritual warfare, healing ministry, and breaking cycles of delay. Bring family prayer requests and expectant faith.

title: Youth Explosion
description: Empowering the next generation with divine purpose, kingdom entrepreneurship, vibrant worship, and holy living. Featuring guest gospel ministers, talent showcases, and keynote breakout sessions.

title: Prayer Vigil
description: All-night prevailing intercession from 9:00 PM to dawn. Crying out for campus revivals, missionary expansion, family restoration, and personal breakthroughs in the Valley of Rephaim.

title: Mwea Mission Outreach & Medical Camp
description: Medical clinic, gospel literature distribution, and open-air crusade reaching agricultural communities across Mwea rice plains. Teams depart from Embu Headquarters.

title: Rombo Mission Outreach & Revival
description: Cross-border evangelical outreach and leadership discipleship training at the slopes of Mount Kilimanjaro. Evangelism teams and pastor training seminar.
